text_0b4e24dce2c7: In STK-anlegen o. bearbeiten, select the Polski language and Poland · OSM network. Search for a station or halt by name or PL identifier. The map zooms to the starting point. Click successive stations and network nodes along your route. If several connections are offered, choose one variant; check the map and add intermediate points. Undo removes the last point. Nodes only hides other reference points without clearing your selection. Set Valid until, at most one year, and select Save. Load, edit or delete your saved Polish paths. Android includes offline search, network and route calculation. Your selection stays as a draft on this device. Saving offline queues a transfer attempt after reconnection. Reload the list afterwards. If the transfer outcome is uncertain, check saved paths first. German knowledge and original GPS data remain separate. PL identifiers are OSM references, not DS100, PKP or UIC numbers. Junctions and endpoints are derived from OSM geometry, not confirmed official reporting points. Source: OSM/Geofabrik, 19 November 2026. 3,089 of 3,366 stations and halts are matched. 277 points without an unambiguous track match remain visible but cannot be selected. This is not a complete official operating-point register. Automatic direction-based GPS qualification for Poland is not yet connected.
